page: Trace performance analysis injecting code into lifecycles. Identify performance bottlenecks. Callback listener for lifecycle events. Trace method with callback. Lifecycle events: onRequest, onParse, onTransform, onBeforeHandle, onHandle, onAfterHandle, onMapResponse, onError, onAfterResponse. Trace parameters: id, context, set, store, time, on[Event]. Trace listener: name, begin, end, error, onStop callback. TraceEndDetail: end time, error, elapsed. Child events with onEvent. Not supported with dynamic mode aot:false. Warning requires static functions.

sections.manifest: Trace callback listener. Callback for each lifecycle event. onHandle listener for handle event. OnStop callback after lifecycle end. Elapsed time calculation. Begin/end timing.
Children events. Events except handle have children array. OnEvent listener for each child. Total children count. Elapsed time per child event.
Trace parameter types. Id random unique per request. Context for Elysia context. Set Context.set shortcut. Store context.store data access. Time request timestamp. On[Event] listeners for lifecycle.
Trace listener parameters. Name function name or 'anonymous'. Begin start time. End promise resolved time. Error thrown error promise. OnStop callback at end.
TraceEndDetail parameters. End time when function ended. Error thrown or null. Elapsed end-begin duration. OnStop callback receives detail.
